Package index

Reading and writing data

The core contract: a variable holds a path, not the data. write_data() returns the file it wrote, and every downstream step re-reads it. This is deliberate memory management for large MS data.

write_data()
Writes data to one or several files
get_data()
Loads data from a file name or returns if already in R
open_data()
Loads data from a file name
get_data_m()
Combines a get_data(), map() and bind_rows()

Temporary files

write_data() without a file name writes into tempdir(). These list, measure and clear what accumulated there.

tempdir_list()
List all temporary files saved by write_data() when
tempdir_remove()
Removing all temporary files saved by write_data() when
tempdir_size()
List size of all temporary files saved by write_data() when

Nested lists on disk

A list is written as a folder of files (.parquetlist) rather than one large .Rds, so single elements can be read without loading the rest.

load_objects()
Loads saved objects from one or several store directories
.save_objects_recursively()
Saves a nested list as a folder of single files
.read_objects_recursively()
Reads a folder of files back into a nested list

Datasets

The dataset store. A dataset is a folder holding variables, observations and any number of long observations x variables data frames. The registry lives in two objects in the global environment: .Datasets (paths) and Datasets (previews).

get_dataset()
Checks and returns correct dataset identifier
get_dataset_names()
Prints or returns all dataset names
.add_dataset()
Registers a new dataset and creates its folder layout
retag_datasets()
Change name or copy data before saving the RData environment

Variables

Per-variable annotation (precursors, peptides, protein groups).

get_variables()
Return variables
get_variables_data()
Return variables data
get_variables_data_names()
Returns variables data column names
add_variables_data()
Add variables data to data frame
save_variables_data()
Adds or updates variables data in a dataset
.save_variables_data()
Writes the variables data of a dataset to disk

Observations

Per-observation annotation (runs, samples, conditions).

get_observations()
Return observations
get_observations_data()
Return observations data
get_observations_data_names()
Returns observations data column names
add_observations_data()
Add observations data to data frame
save_observations_data()
Adds or updates observations data in a dataset
.save_observations_data()
Writes the observations data of a dataset to disk

Data frames

The measured values themselves, stored long and read back on demand.

get_data_frame()
Assemble data frame from dataset
get_data_frame_names()
Prints or returns data names
open_data_frame()
Assemble data frame from dataset
save_data_frame()
Saves a data frame into a dataset store
.save_data_frame()
Writes a data frame of a dataset to disk

Importing DIA-NN reports

Turn a DIA-NN report straight into a dataset store, without ever holding the whole report in memory.

import_diann()
Imports a DIA-NN report into a dataset store
import_diann_channel()
Imports a channel-labelled (e.g. SILAC) DIA-NN report into a dataset store
check_report()
Summarises a DIA-NN report without importing it
.add_defaults()
Registers the default column sets used by the DIA-NN importers
.get_defaults()
Returns a default column set used by the DIA-NN importers

String helpers

Splitting and locating inside identifiers such as P12345_SEQ_1_20.

strsplit_()
Same as strsplit but option to return as vector and to convert to numeric
strsplit_keep()
Performs strsplit and keeps elements specified by vector
strsplit_keep_first()
Performs strsplit and keeps first element of each string
strsplit_keep_firstn()
Performs strsplit and keeps first n elements of each string
strsplit_keep_last()
Performs strsplit and keeps first n elements of each string
strsplit_keep_lastn()
Performs strsplit and keeps first n elements of each string
str_rev()
Returns given strings in reverse order
str_locate_last()
Locates last position of pattern in given string

Small tools

Short helpers used constantly in analysis code.

cc()
Vector with elements as names
fu()
F(actors) U(nique)
fus()
F(actors) U(nique) S(orted)
cleanMem()
Garbage collection function ruthlessly copied from https://stackoverflow.com/a/1467334
cleanup()
Remove objects from the global environment
`%>%`
Pipe operator

Code-writing helpers

Print pasteable code snippets to the console. The .cat_get_* writers are interactive and prompt for a dataset and columns.

.cat_character()
Prints vectors to console in as character vector
.cat_character_named()
Prints vectors to console in as character vector
.cat_function()
Prints function snippet to console and clipboard
.cat_get_data_frame()
Writer function for get_data_frame
.cat_get_data_frame_m()
Writer function for get_data_frame
.cat_get_observations_data()
Writer function for get_observations_data
.cat_get_variables_data()
Writer function for get_variables_data
.cat_gsub_n()
Substitutes pattern multiple times and prints output as code
.cat_numeric()
Prints vectors to console in as character vector
